holiday_surges.name: Christmas / New Year Peak
holiday_surges.guidance: Avoid departures Dec 18-24 and returns Jan 1-8. Recommend outbound Dec 13-15 and return after Jan 15.

holiday_surges.name: US Summer Peak (Outbound)
holiday_surges.guidance: Returns to US after mid-June experience summer holiday rate increases.

holiday_surges.name: US Memorial Day Weekend
holiday_surges.guidance: Avoid domestic US connections over Memorial Day weekend.

sweet_spots.name: Pre-Holiday Shoulder Window
sweet_spots.notes: Last available window before holiday fare classes sell out.

sweet_spots.name: May Shoulder Season (Latin America)
sweet_spots.notes: Low season pricing, pleasant autumn weather in Southern Hemisphere, low load factors.

sweet_spots.name: Post-Holiday January Rebound
sweet_spots.notes: Fares normalize after New Year travel crush.
